title: Aces & Eights: the invasion and Bully Ray’s deception
summary: Masked attackers invade TNA before Bully Ray reveals that his apparent defense of the company was a con. The faction reaches the world championship, then unravels into betrayal and forced dissolution.

chapters.title: Masked attackers target Sting
chapters.result: The group later known as Aces & Eights attacks Sting.
chapters.context: The anonymous assault begins the mystery of who is behind the invasion and how the attackers are gaining access to TNA.

chapters.title: Bully Ray reveals the con
chapters.result: Bully Ray defeats Jeff Hardy for the world title and reveals himself as the faction’s leader.
chapters.context: Devon supplies the hammer used to finish Hardy. Bully’s alliance with the Hogans is exposed as part of the storyline deception.

chapters.title: Anderson forces the club to disband
chapters.result: Mr. Anderson defeats Bully Ray under a disband-or-leave stipulation.
chapters.context: A former member turns on the president and wins the match that ends Aces & Eights as an active faction.
